name: Trusty Steed: On Enter, target ally you control gets +2 POWER until end of turn
notes: NORM (no advanced element) ALLY, so no Subcards lineage patch is needed. Dungeon Guide is seeded on the field first as the only other ally, so ZoneSearch('myField', ['ALLY']) with the 'pop self off the end' trick (GeneratedMacroCode.php:11162) leaves exactly one legal target. Unlike a SPELL activation (favorable-winds-ally-life-buff), this ALLY's On Enter target choice is queued directly after the last reserve payment -- there is no EffectStack decline step here (confirmed via a throwaway debug harness, DevTools/debug_steed.php, now deleted, using EngineRunAction to reload gamestate between each step for reliability). Sending an extra decline ('-') would get consumed AS the target choice itself, with chosen='-' silently skipping the AddTurnEffects call (GeneratedMacroCode.php:30146-30157). Base POWER 1 + 2 = 3, confirmed via computed_power_equals.

rulesClauses: On Enter, target ally you control gets +2 POWER until end of turn.
